differences.old: Opaque cursor to pass to the next call to continue after the last item.
differences.new: Opaque continuation cursor or an exclusive item anchor in the requested visible turn. An item anchor requires a non-empty `turnId`; ascending (the default) returns items after it, and descending returns items before it. Continue with the returned string cursor.

differences.new: Error associated with a failed or interrupted turn.
